sources.title: RoBERTa-Large: Optimized Transformer
sources.snippet: RoBERTa-Large is a transformer-based language model with 24 layers and approximately 355 million parameters that improves BERT pretraining by eliminating NSP and applying dynamic masking.

sources.title: roberta-large: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
